what: The big wordmark and hashtag bands flow by themselves with AutoScroll on an Embla carousel loop (.4 per frame — same speed as the three original bands, the second band is center-aligned). Dragging by hand pushes with Embla’s native drag physics and snaps to a slot, and by default the flow stops afterward like the original (stopOnInteraction). If the band content is short, it is duplicated up to 2.2x the panel width to loop seamlessly

options.speed: Amount flowing per frame (AutoScroll speed), default .4 — original hero strip .4, magazine hero strip .4
options.align: Embla slide alignment start (default)·center — the original second strip (small Chinese-character line) uses center
options.dir: forward (default, to the left) · backward (to the right)
options.stop: interaction (default, pauses on drag or when focus enters — original) · hover (pauses while hovered) · none (never pauses)
options.free: If true, after dragging and releasing it glides instead of snapping to a slot (dragFree)
options.[data-fx-part=track]: Flow line (child). If none, the first child — its children become the cells

note: Load _vendor/embla-carousel@8.6.0/embla-carousel.umd.js and embla-carousel-auto-scroll@8.6.0 before the parts. The original sets pointer-events: none on the text inside the strip so it only receives dragging

from.where: index.html border strips (large English wordmark row · small school name row align: center) · magazine hashtag strip, news.html hero hashtag strip — original main-*.js oe(): Embla {loop, align: start, skipSnaps, containScroll: trimSnaps} + AutoScroll {speed: .4, startDelay: 0}
